ursa_earthshock.desc: Ursa slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemies in a nearby radius.

ursa_overpower.desc: Gives bonus attack speed for a number of attacks.

ursa_enrage.desc: Reduces incoming damage and applies a strong dispel.

mirana_arrow.desc: Fires a long-range arrow that will stun and damage the first enemy unit it strikes.

mirana_starfall.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units.
